# Zero Tick Farms v1.1.0: Minecraft 26.3

Updated for Minecraft 26.3. No gameplay changes from v1.0.0.

A Fabric port of tildejustin's 0 Tick Crops (migrated from Yarn to Mojang mappings).
Restores 0-tick plant growth: forcing a scheduled tick on a supported plant
(e.g. a pulsed sticky piston beside it) makes it grow.

> **Pre-release:** builds and loads on 26.3. Full in-game farm testing is still in progress.

## Supported plants

- Bamboo
- Cactus
- Chorus flower
- Sugar cane
- Kelp
- Twisting vines
- Weeping vines

## Not supported in 26.3

Crops (wheat/carrots/potatoes/beetroot), cocoa, nether wart, sweet berries, and vines
can no longer be 0-ticked. Mojang has patched their tick scheduling since 1.16.
Farmland, fluids, and redstone ore have no growth to trigger and are not included.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer
- Fabric API (26.3)

## Install

Put Fabric API and `zero-tick-farms-v1.1.0.jar` in your `mods/` folder.

## Older versions

On Minecraft 26.1.2? Use [v1.0.0](https://github.com/madelainedalangin/zero-tick-farms/releases/tag/v1.0.0).

## Credit

Original mod by tildejustin (MIT). This is a community port to 26.3.
